params.patch_scope: Prompt text vectorizer and linear classifier only.

proposal.why_this_operator_applies: B1 is a binary text classification task; word n-grams are the cheapest lexical safety baseline.
proposal.hypothesis: Arabic harmful-prompt labels expose repeated lexical and phrase cues that a balanced linear model can capture.
proposal.change_surface: Prompt text vectorizer and linear classifier only.
proposal.expected_effect: Beat majority baseline on macro-F1 without relying on external scorer.
proposal.risk: Dialect spelling variation and obfuscation may make word tokens brittle.
proposal.cheapest_validation: Train on public train.csv and compute local macro-F1 on dev_with_label.csv.
proposal.rollback_stop_condition: Prune if macro-F1 does not improve the current best local gate score.

params.patch_scope: Replace word tokenization with char_wb n-grams.

proposal.why_this_operator_applies: Arabic dialect, spelling variation, and unsafe-content obfuscation make character features useful.
proposal.hypothesis: Character n-grams will reduce unsafe-as-safe misses relative to word-only features.
proposal.change_surface: Replace word tokenization with char_wb n-grams.
proposal.expected_effect: Improve macro-F1 and unsafe recall on local dev.
proposal.risk: Character features may overfit short artifacts and increase safe-as-unsafe errors.
proposal.cheapest_validation: Compare local macro-F1 and confusion matrix against round 1.
proposal.rollback_stop_condition: Prune if it fails to beat the current best macro-F1.

params.patch_scope: Feature union only; same linear classifier family.

proposal.why_this_operator_applies: The previous two candidates test complementary lexical views; B1 may benefit from combining them.
proposal.hypothesis: A combined word+character representation captures phrase cues and spelling robustness together.
proposal.change_surface: Feature union only; same linear classifier family.
proposal.expected_effect: Improve macro-F1 while keeping the method simple and reproducible.
proposal.risk: Higher-dimensional features may overfit dev and slow iteration.
proposal.cheapest_validation: One local train/dev run with the same gate.
proposal.rollback_stop_condition: Prune if it does not beat the current best score by the gate delta.

params.patch_scope: Input representation includes dialect token plus prompt text.

gate.reason: Local macro-F1 0.922415 did not improve current best 0.928714 by delta 0.001.

proposal.why_this_operator_applies: The released data includes dialect; dialect-conditioned text may capture distribution shifts cheaply.
proposal.hypothesis: Appending dialect as a stable token helps separate dialect-specific lexical risk cues.
proposal.change_surface: Input representation includes dialect token plus prompt text.
proposal.expected_effect: Improve macro-F1 or keep score while reducing dialect-specific misses.
proposal.risk: Dialect token can encode split artifacts and overfit local dev.
proposal.cheapest_validation: Use the same train/dev gate and do not claim official improvement.
proposal.rollback_stop_condition: Prune if it does not improve the current best local gate score.
